description:
Configure Area Code Caller ID (AC-CID) for the 'Northeast Presence' campaign (ID: NEASTPRS) to enable local presence dialing. 

Goal: Add the following 6 Area Code to Caller ID mappings in the AC-CID section of the campaign and ensure the campaign is set to use them.

Mappings:
- Area Code 212 -> Caller ID: 2125559901 (New York)
- Area Code 617 -> Caller ID: 6175559902 (Boston)
- Area Code 215 -> Caller ID: 2155559903 (Philadelphia)
- Area Code 860 -> Caller ID: 8605559904 (Hartford)
- Area Code 609 -> Caller ID: 6095559905 (Trenton)
- Area Code 203 -> Caller ID: 2035559906 (Bridgeport)

Navigate to the Campaign Detail screen for 'NEASTPRS', find the AC-CID specifications, add these entries, and ensure the 'Use AC-CID' (or Areacode CID) setting is enabled for the campaign.
